Primary skin lymphoma composed of malignant mature T cells; lymphoma warrants the immune mechanism axis.
Drug-induced dysfunction of central respiratory control; no intrinsic airway or lung damage established. Cardiovascular effects are later risks.
Heme synthesis defect with defining cutaneous phototoxicity. Liver failure occurs in ~5%; anemia is variable and separately diagnosed.
Absent kidneys; pulmonary hypoplasia 80-99%, intestinal/fistulous and cardiovascular malformations 30-79%. Sacral anomalies 30-79% omitted by cap.
SCN8A-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; hypotonia and motor delay reflect neurologic dysfunction.
Acute myeloid leukemia involving marrow and myeloid blood cells; no common additional organ damage established.
Inherited bile acid synthesis defect with defining hepatic fibrosis and failure. Iron deficiency anemia is separately diagnosed.
Tuberculous infection directly involving the intestine; pulmonary involvement is not required.
Skeletal dysplasia defined by brachydactyly, abnormal thumbs and great toes, and fibular overgrowth.
Congenital skeletal muscle myopathy. Respiratory insufficiency and dysphagia can reflect muscle weakness without intrinsic lung or gut disease.
Inherited ventricular arrhythmia; syncope and vertigo do not establish separate neurologic or vestibular damage.
Benign vascular neoplasm arising in the brain; both cerebral location and blood vessel origin define it.
Benign perivascular smooth muscle neoplasm arising in dermis or subcutis; no skeletal muscle disease established.
Thoracic malignancy classified under respiratory system cancer and respiratory tract neoplasm.
Tuberculous infection of ocular tissues, particularly iris, ciliary body, and choroid.
Parasitic infestation of the epidermal surface or burrows within skin; no additional organ applies across most subtypes.
Necrosis of middle ear auditory ossicles; the affected structures belong to the hearing apparatus.
Spastic paraplegia, neuropathy, and optic atrophy define SPOAN. Structural joint contractures affect 80-99%; scoliosis occurs in 14/22 (~64%).
CA2 deficiency causes osteopetrosis and renal tubular acidosis. Neurologic dysfunction/calcification is defining, reported in 30-79%; dental defects omitted by cap.
Central and peripheral motor neuron disease; muscle wasting is denervation-related, without evidence of a separate primary muscle process.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual and speech impairment. Strabismus 25%, hearing deficits and optic atrophy below 30%; hypotonia alone adds no muscle axis.
Inherited atrial fibrillation. Thromboembolic stroke occurred in 11/16, but is a separately diagnosed complication and is excluded.
Polyp arising in the colon; no additional organ involvement defines the umbrella concept.
